## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Spec: `specs/NNNN-name/` and requirement IDs. For a typo/format-only change,
identify the existing spec and explain why behavior is unchanged.

Components: list workspace IDs. Record compatibility/runtime boundary changes
in the spec and an ADR when applicable.

## Validation

Commands run and relevant results. State whether GPU/model tests were run.

Update the spec's verification.md with actual acceptance results. State which
cloud/GUI/GPU/Windows checks were not run; never treat mock checks as real service
or hardware validation.
